comment: A transform under way stays where it is while Space pans, and Enter applies it after. A painter's expectation: "when in transform mode ... I ofthen use the pan tool (hold space) to move, because I am zoomed in. But when I press the space, the moved stuff jumps back because I 'switched' a tool." A red stroke is painted on a layer named Paint and the view is zoomed in (shot 1, texel reads the layer's own alpha as 1 at the stroke's middle point 500,470). The transform tool opens and its body is dragged clear of where the stroke was painted (shot 2, the state dump gives the move as offset x -120 y 80). Space is held and the view is dragged (shot 3): canvases[].offset has moved, and the transform block still reads moving true with the same pending box, offset and quad, so the picture did not jump back to where it was painted. Space is let go (shot 4, still in hand) and Enter lands the move (shot 5): texel reads the layer's alpha as 1 at the moved middle point 380,550 and as 0 at the old one, and the paint is still under the pan.
